The '''southeast quadrant''' was an area of [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] for use in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] during or prior to [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]]. The area was next to a back-up [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] and was designated as the staging area during evacuation for a number of the bases staff. When [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces attack the base the staff evacuated from the site included [[Human/Legends|Human]] surgeon [[Jos Vondar]], [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] surgeon [[Zan Yant]], [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] nurse [[Tolk le Trene]], [[Equani]] minder [[Klo Merit]] and [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]].<ref name="MI:BS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Southeast quadrant first appeared in [[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]], the first novel in the [[MedStar Duology]] written by [[Steve Perry]] and [[Michael Reaves]] and published in [[2004]].<ref name="MI:BS" />
